findings.classification: SHOWN static and independently observed under early transport guard
findings.title: Risk audit is not stubbed; swallowed transport failures do not fail the tests
findings.detail: Orchestrator audit and memory audit are stubbed, but risk_stub.emit_audit_event is not. Real risk_status invokes the real shared audit helper, which constructs an HTTP client and catches ordinary exceptions. In the one independent run an early non-ASGI HTTP transport guard blocked three POST attempts to the synthetic fixture audit endpoint, one per case. All tests still passed because the errors were swallowed.
findings.impact: Exactly two synthetic tool requests does not mean exactly two total HTTP attempts or zero attempted audit effects. Passing socket/transport assertions can be swallowed by production code. No external request completed in this review.
findings.disposition: Nonblocking for diagnosis-only acceptance. The harness is not accepted as wholly in-process/no-attempt proof. A later test-only change should stub risk audit or assert independently collected forbidden-attempt counters stay empty. No fix made here.

predicate_limits.classification: SHOWN source mismatch, not historical value recovery
predicate_limits.detail: Populated summaries contain latest_ts/latest_source outside the verifier market whitelist and ok=true; positive-price case also violates the no-price condition. The whitelist check precedes the later value checks. These cases demonstrate group rejection, not each predicate as an independently observed runtime failure. A zero price is not no rows/no market evidence.
predicate_limits.five_false: Fail-closed aggregate, not five independent failures.
predicate_limits.historical_limit: No inference that the actual failed run contained either synthetic row/shape or that its exact predicate was this whitelist check.

proposal_assessment.classification: Supported design candidate only; no implementation approval
proposal_assessment.rationale: A deliberately archival proof can truthfully say market evidence is excluded by its profile rather than falsely asserting no database rows. Controlled present-row cases justify making this distinction explicit; they do not justify accepting prices or a broader arbitrary snapshot.
future_requirements: Exact closed exclusion marker bound to strict archival protocol/identity, never a global waiver.
Prices and market-derived evidence remain absent; unsupported, extra or contradictory fields must refuse.
Preserve ordinary research market retrieval/summary/reasoning without system-wide capability removal.
Preserve archive/lineage/body/witness/citation/identity/no-trading gates, all-five-true acceptance and existing timeouts/no-retry boundaries.
Never relabel populated data no_market_data; never widen the whitelist merely to accept any producer object.
Future implementation requires separate empty/populated/ordinary/adversarial tests and independent review; marker semantics and ordinary-path preservation after change are not tested here.
proposal_assessment.not_authorized: No source/verifier change, new marker, acceptance relaxation, packet refresh, service/startup/retry/query or actual attempt authorized.
